content.query:
resources
| where ['type'] =~ "microsoft.maintenance/maintenanceconfigurations"
| where location in~ ({Location})
| where properties.maintenanceScope == "InGuestPatch"
| project id = tolower(id)
| join kind=leftouter (
    maintenanceresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.maintenance/configurationassignments"
    | extend splitArr = split(id, "/")
    | extend isDynamicScope = array_length(splitArr) == 7 or array_length(splitArr) == 9
    | extend maintenanceConfigurationId = tolower(tostring(properties.maintenanceConfigurationId))
) on $left.id == $right.maintenanceConfigurationId
| summarize totalNumberOfSchedules = dcount(id), noOfStaticAssignments = dcountif(id, isDynamicScope == false), noOfDynamicScopes = dcountif(id, isDynamicScope == true)
| project machinePack = pack("Total schedules", totalNumberOfSchedules, "Total number of machines attached", noOfStaticAssignments, "Total number of dynamic scopes", noOfDynamicScopes)
| mv-expand machinePack
| extend machine = tostring(bag_keys(machinePack)[0])
| extend tileRank = case(machine =~ "Total schedules", 0, machine =~ "Total number of machines attached", 1, 2)
| extend count_ = tolong(machinePack[machine])
| project tileRank, machine, count_

content.json:
# Maintenance configurations

Please make sure to select all the subscriptions across which the machines are present for accurate count of attached VMs and dynamic scopes.

content.query:
resources
| where ['type'] =~ "microsoft.maintenance/maintenanceconfigurations"
| where location in~ ({Location})
| where properties.maintenanceScope == "InGuestPatch"
| project id = tolower(id), name, location, tostring(properties.maintenanceWindow.duration),  tostring(properties.maintenanceWindow.timeZone), tostring(properties.maintenanceWindow.startDateTime), tostring(properties.maintenanceWindow.endDateTime), tostring(properties.maintenanceWindow.recurEvery), installPatchesProperties = properties.installPatches
| join kind=leftouter (
    maintenanceresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.maintenance/configurationassignments"
    | extend splitArr = split(id, "/")
    | extend isDynamicScope = array_length(splitArr) == 7 or array_length(splitArr) == 9
    | extend maintenanceConfigurationId = tolower(tostring(properties.maintenanceConfigurationId))
    | summarize noOfStaticAssignments = dcountif(id, isDynamicScope == false), noOfDynamicScopes = dcountif(id, isDynamicScope) by maintenanceConfigurationId
) on $left.id == $right.maintenanceConfigurationId
| extend noOfStaticAssignments = iff(isnull(noOfStaticAssignments), 0, noOfStaticAssignments), noOfDynamicScopes = iff(isnull(noOfDynamicScopes), 0, noOfDynamicScopes)
| extend staticState = iff(noOfStaticAssignments > 0, "has", "none"), dynamicState = iff(noOfDynamicScopes > 0, "has", "none")

content.query:
maintenanceresources
| where ['type'] =~ "microsoft.maintenance/configurationassignments"
| where properties.maintenanceConfigurationId =~ '{maintenanceConfigurationID}'
| extend splitArr = split(id, "/")
| where not(array_length(splitArr) == 7 or array_length(splitArr) == 9) // Condition to identify static assignments
| extend vmId = tostring(properties.resourceId)
| project vmId, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, tocName = iff(vmId contains "hybridcompute", "updateManagement", "unifiedUpdateManagement")

content.json: # Dynamic scopes attached to the maintenance configuration

content.query:
maintenanceresources
| where ['type'] =~ "microsoft.maintenance/configurationassignments"
| where properties.maintenanceConfigurationId =~ '{maintenanceConfigurationID}'
| extend splitArr = split(id, "/")
| where array_length(splitArr) == 7 or array_length(splitArr) == 9 // Condition to identify dynamic scopes
| extend criteria = properties['filter']
| extend _tagsBag = criteria.tagSettings.tags
| extend _hasTagFilter = isnotnull(_tagsBag) and array_length(bag_keys(_tagsBag)) > 0
| extend _tagsOp = tostring(coalesce(criteria.tagSettings.filterOperator, "All"))
| extend _tagsJson = tostring(_tagsBag)
| extend _tagsFlat = replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(_tagsJson, '{', ''), '}', ''), '"', '')
| extend _tagsFlat = replace_string(_tagsFlat, ':[', '=')
| extend _tagsFlat = replace_string(_tagsFlat, '],', '||')
| extend _tagsFlat = trim_end(@'\]', _tagsFlat)
| project id,
    resourceGroups = iff(isnull(criteria.resourceGroups), '(any)', strcat_array(criteria.resourceGroups, ',')),
    resourceTypes = iff(isnull(criteria.resourceTypes), '(any)', strcat_array(criteria.resourceTypes, ',')),
    tagSettings = iff(_hasTagFilter, tostring(criteria.tagSettings), '(any)'),
    tagSettingsEncoded = iff(_hasTagFilter, strcat(_tagsOp, '||', _tagsFlat), '(any)'),
    locations = iff(isnull(criteria.locations), '(any)', strcat_array(criteria.locations, ',')),
    osTypes = iff(isnull(criteria.osTypes), '(any)', strcat_array(criteria.osTypes, ',')),
    availabilityZones = criteria.availabilityZones,
    properties
content.noDataMessage: No dynamic scopes present in this schedule.

content.json: <u>**Please select a dynamic scope from the grid above to preview the resources matching its filter criteria.**</u>

# Resources matching the selected dynamic scope

Preview of resources (VMs and Arc-enabled machines) that match the resource group, resource type, location, OS type, and tag filters of the selected dynamic scope.

content.query:
resources
| extend osType = tostring(coalesce(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType, properties.osType, properties.osName, properties.osProfile.osType))
| where {dsResourceTypes} == "(any)" or type in~ (split({dsResourceTypes}, ','))
| where {dsResourceGroups} == "(any)" or resourceGroup in~ (split({dsResourceGroups}, ','))
| where {dsLocations} == "(any)" or location in~ (split({dsLocations}, ','))
| where {dsOsTypes} == "(any)" or osType in~ (split({dsOsTypes}, ','))
| extend _hasTagFilter = {dsTagSettings} != "(any)"
| extend _tagParts = split({dsTagSettings}, '||')
| extend _filterOp = tolower(tostring(_tagParts[0]))
| extend _pairCount = iff(_hasTagFilter, array_length(_tagParts) - 1, 0)
| extend _p0k = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[1]),'=')[0]), _p0v = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[1]),'=')[1])
| extend _p1k = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[2]),'=')[0]), _p1v = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[2]),'=')[1])
| extend _p2k = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[3]),'=')[0]), _p2v = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[3]),'=')[1])
| extend _p3k = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[4]),'=')[0]), _p3v = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[4]),'=')[1])
| extend _p4k = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[5]),'=')[0]), _p4v = tostring(split(tostring(_tagParts[5]),'=')[1])
| extend _h0 = iff(_pairCount < 1, 0, iff(tostring(tags[_p0k]) =~ _p0v, 1, 0))
| extend _h1 = iff(_pairCount < 2, 0, iff(tostring(tags[_p1k]) =~ _p1v, 1, 0))
| extend _h2 = iff(_pairCount < 3, 0, iff(tostring(tags[_p2k]) =~ _p2v, 1, 0))
| extend _h3 = iff(_pairCount < 4, 0, iff(tostring(tags[_p3k]) =~ _p3v, 1, 0))
| extend _h4 = iff(_pairCount < 5, 0, iff(tostring(tags[_p4k]) =~ _p4v, 1, 0))
| extend _hits = _h0 + _h1 + _h2 + _h3 + _h4
| where not(_hasTagFilter) or (_filterOp == "any" and _hits > 0) or (_filterOp != "any" and _hits == _pairCount)
| extend patchSettings = iff(osType =~ "windows", properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.patchSettings, properties.osProfile.linuxConfiguration.patchSettings)
| extend patchAssessment = tostring(patchSettings.patchMode)
| extend bypassPlatformSafetyChecks = tostring(patchSettings.automaticByPlatformSettings.bypassPlatformSafetyChecksOnUserSchedule)
| extend enableHotpatching = tostring(patchSettings.enableHotpatching)
| extend status = tostring(coalesce(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.displayStatus, properties.status))
| extend parentClusterResourceId = tostring(properties.parentClusterResourceId)
| where isnull(parentClusterResourceId) or isempty(parentClusterResourceId)
| project id, name, type, location, osType, patchAssessment, bypassPlatformSafetyChecks, enableHotpatching, status, tags
content.noDataMessage: No resources match the selected dynamic scope filters.
